payload.entry: Resolved sase-1mm: research commit 43e9066b removes only the hand-added Topic Tags pointer from the generated README; TAGS.md and report tags frontmatter remain. Verified .venv/bin/sase init repo --check reports no work and .venv/bin/sase validate passes (with the existing deferred skill-sync warning).

Verified research README matches the generated template at sidecar commit 43e9066b; TAGS.md and tags frontmatter remain. init repo --check reports no work; sase validate passes with only the deferred provider skill-sync warning.

Phase evidence: fixed RepoCreationFormWidget control-readiness so owner-switch remounts cannot query missing #repo-creation-form-errors. _controls_ready now resets on unmount, re-arms on every mount, and _ready_to_touch_controls() clears the flag when composed controls are absent. Create-form paint retries once after refresh if it still raises, so a paint failure cannot strand _create_form_status at loading. Programmatic owner-switch restores are ignored as project-name edits (_syncing + ignore-map). Addresses the sase-1mk.6 regression (Master Gate 39159243248 test (8) and Full CI 39155173153 all three test legs). sase-1mi (test_name_collision_blocks_review_but_occupied_checkout_surfaces) and sase-1m9 (test_review_back_restores_draft_and_y_stores_model_submission) still pass. Stress: 20/20 iterations under SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=8 of create_flow + create_races + configure_review + repo_creation_form + create + create_defaults (40 tests/iter, 800 passed). Full tests/ace/tui/modals/test_new_project_*.py: 192 passed. No --epic-symbol leftovers.
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: test_sigterm_leaves_run_running 124 vs 143 under loaded sase tool run check 8639c2fc8bdf82b78be380c36c544641 — already tracked by sase-1fi; passed in isolation in 7.74s

Decision: the JUMP title itself is unchanged. db14df00e6 is intended product: a clan with exactly one Stopped member (here member06 QUESTION; FAILED is Failed, WAITING is Waiting) now shows the Enter footer hint. The mix snapshot drifted because that extra <enter> choose action binding wraps the footer to 3 lines and shifts the layout (~6% pixels). JUMP chrome stays JUMP · CLAN MEMBERS 00-13 with no WAVES suffix and no truncation. Layered JUMP goldens (60/80/120) were unchanged, so the 4 WAVES +… title in the plan snapshot was a mix-up with the layered fixture. Updated agents_jump_panel_collapsed_in_flight_mix_120x40.png. just fix-tui-screenshots --check over jump_panel + clan_panel + clans + modals (Act-on chooser) + group/panel clan collapse + archive_actions + tribe_clan_summaries: 45 unchanged. Host-independence: mix node check-clean twice, TZ=UTC and TZ=America/New_York, no unstable. Newest completed Full CI visual-test is 39155173153 (only this golden). No task bead owned this concurrent-commit drift.
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: test_blocked_render_is_bounded_and_leaves_the_request_queued 30.49s vs <5s under the same loaded check — already tracked by sase-xo; passed in isolation in 0.43s

Verified JUMP mix golden: db14df00e6 Enter hint is intended; updated agents_jump_panel_collapsed_in_flight_mix_120x40.png (footer <enter> choose action, JUMP title still JUMP · CLAN MEMBERS 00-13 with no truncated WAVES suffix). Related clan/footer/chooser goldens unchanged (45). Host-independence TZ=UTC and TZ=America/New_York check-clean, no unstable. Full CI 39155173153 visual-test only this golden. sase tool run check 8639c2fc8bdf82b78be380c36c544641: lint/validation passed; two loaded-lane flakes (sase-1fi, sase-xo) passed in isolation. epic-symbols empty.

Closed by explicit `sase stitch create -B close` after create_commit landed 7f3c8d0965 ("fix(ace): keep New Project form controls ready after owner switch"). The commit author requested bead completion after verifying the bead scope. Reopen with `sase bead open sase-1mk.9.4` if more work remains.
